name: Dragon Adventures
notes: Dragon Adventures 0.9.1-r2: Low companion LOD is a single vertex-coloured mesh so animals stay under the 70-draw cap (ideally ≤68) with no High visual change. After an update or any load where the page is unfocused, and whenever the window blurs mid-play, a Tap to keep playing overlay pauses the game until a click or tap refocuses the canvas. Pickaxe tooltip is context-aware (Click to mine this rock / Walk up to a rock to mine). Mounted mining uses a wider look-ray so a rock centred within about 6 m can be mined from the saddle. Schema v5, IDB/cacheId/test-* denylist unchanged. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
